about_the_game:
TRI-GER is a vector based top down shoot-em-up inspired by classic arcade games. With your ability to switch colors and upgrade your arsenal, your job is to fight endless waves of multi-color enemy insectoids and maximize your high score. Match the color of your blaster with the enemies you're shooting to increase your damage and rack up combos, but be careful! Color matching is a two way street, so enemies that share your color have the same advantages. Features:

  • Switch between 3 colors to maximize damage dealt to enemy insectoids,

  • Upgrades for both you and the insectoids as the game progresses,

  • Boss battles at the end of every wave,

  • A radiance meter to build up and activate a temporary invincible mode,

  • Support for color blindness via dynamic desaturation of certain hues,
